```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Set up

Load the packages:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(plotrix)
library(rempsyc)
library(emmeans)
```

Load the data:

```{r}
full_data <- read_csv("rawdata.csv")

# check the data

full_data
```

# Exclude the extreme values

Step 1: exclude data below 100 ms or above 5000 ms
Step 2: exclude data that were over 2.5 standard deviations from the grand mean.

The critical region:

```{r}
critical_1 <- filter(full_data,
                     position == "critical")

critical_2 <- filter(critical_1,
                     RT < 5000 & RT > 100)

data_critical <- filter(critical_2,
                        RT < mean(RT) + 2.5 * sd(RT) &
                        RT > mean(RT) - 2.5 * sd(RT))
```

The spill1 region:

```{r}
spill1_1 <- filter(full_data,
                   position == "spill1")

spill1_2 <- filter(spill1_1,
                   RT < 5000 & RT > 100)

data_spill1 <- filter(spill1_2,
                      RT < mean(RT) + 2.5 * sd(RT) &
                      RT > mean(RT) - 2.5 * sd(RT))
```

The spill2 region:

```{r}
spill2_1 <- filter(full_data,
                   position == "spill2")

spill2_2 <- filter(spill2_1,
                   RT < 5000 & RT > 100)

data_spill2 <- filter(spill2_2,
                      RT < mean(RT) + 2.5 * sd(RT) &
                      RT > mean(RT) - 2.5 * sd(RT))
```

The spill3 region:

```{r}
spill3_1 <- filter(full_data,
                   position == "spill3")

spill3_2 <- filter(spill3_1,
                   RT < 5000 & RT > 100)

data_spill3 <- filter(spill3_2,
                      RT < mean(RT) + 2.5 * sd(RT) &
                      RT > mean(RT) - 2.5 * sd(RT))
```

The spill4 region:

```{r}
spill4_1 <- filter(full_data,
                   position == "spill4")

spill4_2 <- filter(spill4_1,
                   RT < 5000 & RT > 100)

data_spill4 <- filter(spill4_2,
                      RT < mean(RT) + 2.5 * sd(RT) &
                      RT > mean(RT) - 2.5 * sd(RT))
```

The spill5 region:

```{r}
spill5_1 <- filter(full_data,
                   position == "spill5")

spill5_2 <- filter(spill5_1,
                   RT < 5000 & RT > 100)

data_spill5 <- filter(spill5_2,
                      RT < mean(RT) + 2.5 * sd(RT) &
                      RT > mean(RT) - 2.5 * sd(RT))
```

Calculate how many data points have been excluded:

```{r}
data_1 <- nrow(critical_1) + nrow(spill1_1) +
  nrow(spill2_1) + nrow(spill3_1) +
  nrow(spill4_1) + nrow(spill5_1)

data_2 <- nrow(critical_2) + nrow(spill1_2) +
  nrow(spill2_2) + nrow(spill3_2) +
  nrow(spill4_2) + nrow(spill5_2)

data_3 <- nrow(data_critical) + nrow(data_spill1) +
  nrow(data_spill2) + nrow(data_spill3) +
  nrow(data_spill4) + nrow(data_spill5)

# the number of data points lost in Step 1:
data_1 - data_2

# the number of data points lost in Step 2:
data_2 - data_3
```

# Descriptive statistics

```{r}
data_final <- dplyr::bind_rows(data_critical,
                               data_spill1,
                               data_spill2,
                               data_spill3,
                               data_spill4,
                               data_spill5)

descr<- 
  data_final %>%
  group_by(position,context,plausibility) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(RT), se = std.error(RT)) %>% 
  mutate(mean = round(mean, digits = 2),
         se = round(se, digits = 2),
         Conditions = str_c(context, "-", plausibility),
         value = str_c(mean, " ± ", se),
         position = str_to_title(position),
         Conditions = str_to_title(Conditions)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(position, Conditions, value) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = position,
              values_from = value)
descr <- nice_table(descr)
print(descr, preview ="docx")

```

# Plot

```{r}
plot_data <- data_final %>%
  group_by(position,context,plausibility) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(RT), se = std.error(RT)) %>% 
  mutate(conditions = str_c(context, "-", plausibility),
         positions = ifelse(position == "critical", '1',
                     ifelse(position == "spill1", '2',
                     ifelse(position == "spill2", '3',
                     ifelse(position == "spill3", '4',
                     ifelse(position == "spill4", '5', '6')))))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(positions, conditions, mean, se)

plot_data$positions <- as.numeric(plot_data$positions)
plot_data$conditions <- factor(plot_data$conditions,
                               levels = c("realistic-plausible",
                                          "realistic-implausible",
                                          "unrealistic-plausible",
                                          "unrealistic-implausible"))

plot1 <- ggplot(data = plot_data, 
                mapping = aes(x = positions, 
                              y = mean, 
                              linetype = conditions,
                              color = conditions)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  xlab(NULL) +
  ylab("Reading times (ms)") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 6, by = 1),
                     labels = c("critical",
                                "spillover1",
                                "spillover2",
                                "spillover3",
                                "spillover4",
                                "spillover5"))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 340, by = 20)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18,face = "bold",color="black")) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18,face = "bold",color="black")) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18,face = "bold",color="black")) +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "serif"))+
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 18,face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 18,face = "bold")) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(keywidth = 1, keyheight = 2),
    linetype=guide_legend(keywidth = 3.6, keyheight = 2),
    colour=guide_legend(keywidth = 3.6, keyheight = 2)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean-1.96*se,
                    ymax = mean+1.96*se),
                width = .1,
                linewidth = 1.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c('black','black','darkgrey','darkgrey'))+
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c (1,2,1,2))

ggsave("Exp 2.tiff", plot1, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 600)

```


# LMM analysis
## Critical region

Prepare the data for lmm analysis:

```{r}
data_critical$context <- as.factor(data_critical$context)
data_critical$context <- relevel(data_critical$context, ref = "realistic")
contrasts(data_critical$context) <- c(-0.5,0.5)

data_critical$plausibility <- as.factor(data_critical$plausibility)
data_critical$plausibility <- relevel(data_critical$plausibility, ref = "plausible")
contrasts(data_critical$plausibility) <- c(-0.5,0.5)

data_critical$subject <- as.factor(data_critical$subject)
data_critical$item <- as.factor(data_critical$item)
data_critical$RT <- as.numeric(data_critical$RT)

data_critical <- data_critical %>%  
  mutate(z_CL = scale(CL)) %>% 
  select(subject, item, context, plausibility, z_CL, RT)
```

Fit the models:

```{r}
critical_mdl01 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + context * plausibility | item) +
                       (1 + context * plausibility * z_CL | subject),
                       data = data_critical,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                              optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(critical_mdl01)$varcor

critical_mdl02 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + context * plausibility || item) +
                       (1 + context * plausibility * z_CL || subject),
                       data = data_critical,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = 'bobyqa',
                                             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(critical_mdl02)$varcor

critical_mdl03 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + context * plausibility || item) +
                       (1 + context * plausibility || subject),
                       data = data_critical,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = 'bobyqa',
                                             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(critical_mdl03)$varcor

critical_mdl04 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + context + plausibility || item) +
                       (1 + context * plausibility || subject),
                       data = data_critical,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = 'bobyqa',
                                             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(critical_mdl04)$varcor

critical_mdl05 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + plausibility || item) +
                       (1 + context + plausibility || subject),
                       data = data_critical,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = 'bobyqa',
                                             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(critical_mdl05)$varcor

critical_mdl06 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + plausibility || item) +
                       (1 + plausibility || subject),
                       data = data_critical,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = 'bobyqa',
                                             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e6)))

critical_mdl07 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 | item) +
                       (1 + plausibility || subject),
                       data = data_critical,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = 'bobyqa',
                                             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(critical_mdl07)$varcor

critical_mdl08 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 | item) +
                       (1 | subject),
                       data = data_critical,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = 'bobyqa',
                                             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(critical_mdl08)

```

## Spill1 region

Prepare the data for lmm analysis:

```{r}
data_spill1$context <- as.factor(data_spill1$context)
data_spill1$context <- relevel(data_spill1$context, ref = "realistic")
contrasts(data_spill1$context) <- c(-0.5,0.5)

data_spill1$plausibility <- as.factor(data_spill1$plausibility)
data_spill1$plausibility <- relevel(data_spill1$plausibility, ref = "plausible")
contrasts(data_spill1$plausibility) <- c(-0.5,0.5)

data_spill1$subject <- as.factor(data_spill1$subject)
data_spill1$item <- as.factor(data_spill1$item)
data_spill1$RT <- as.numeric(data_spill1$RT)

data_spill1 <- data_spill1 %>%  
  mutate(z_CL = scale(CL)) %>% 
  select(subject, item, context, plausibility, z_CL, RT)

```

Fit the models:

```{r}
spill1_mdl01 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + context * plausibility | item) +
                       (1 + context * plausibility * z_CL | subject),
                       data = data_spill1,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                             optCtrl=list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(spill1_mdl01)$varcor

spill1_mdl02 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + context * plausibility || item) +
                       (1 + context * plausibility * z_CL || subject),
                       data = data_spill1,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                             optCtrl=list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(spill1_mdl02)$varcor

spill1_mdl03 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + context * plausibility || item) +
                       (1 + context * plausibility || subject),
                       data = data_spill1,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                             optCtrl=list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(spill1_mdl03)$varcor

spill1_mdl04 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + context + plausibility || item) +
                       (1 + context + plausibility || subject),
                       data = data_spill1,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                             optCtrl=list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(spill1_mdl04)$varcor

spill1_mdl05 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + context + plausibility || item) +
                       (1 + context || subject),
                       data = data_spill1,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                             optCtrl=list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(spill1_mdl05)$varcor

spill1_mdl06 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + context || item) +
                       (1 + context || subject),
                       data = data_spill1,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                             optCtrl=list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(spill1_mdl06)$varcor

spill1_mdl07 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 | item) +
                       (1 + context || subject),
                       data = data_spill1,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                             optCtrl=list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(spill1_mdl07)$varcor

spill1_mdl08 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 | item) +
                       (1 | subject),
                       data = data_spill1,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                             optCtrl=list(maxfun = 1e6)))

summary(spill1_mdl08)

spill1_results <- as.data.frame(summary(spill1_mdl08)$coefficients)
spill1_CI <- confint(spill1_mdl08)
spill1_results <- cbind(spill1_results, spill1_CI[4:11,])
spill1_results <- tibble::rownames_to_column(spill1_results,"Fixed effects")
names(spill1_results) <- c("Fixed effects",
                           "β", "SE", "df",
                           "t", "p", "CI_lower", "CI_upper")
spill1_results <- spill1_results %>%
  mutate(p = p.adjust(p, method="bonferroni")) %>% 
  select("Fixed effects",
         "β", "SE", "t",
         "p", "CI_lower", "CI_upper")

spill1_results <- nice_table(spill1_results)

```

```{r}
  mutate(z_CL = scale(CL)) %>% 
  select(subject, item, context, plausibility, z_CL, RT)
```

Fit the models:

```{r}
spill4_mdl01 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + context * plausibility | item) +
                       (1 + context * plausibility * z_CL | subject),
                       data = data_spill4,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                             optCtrl=list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(spill4_mdl01)$varcor

spill4_mdl02 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + context * plausibility || item) +
                       (1 + context * plausibility * z_CL || subject),
                       data = data_spill4,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                             optCtrl=list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(spill4_mdl02)$varcor

spill4_mdl03 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + context * plausibility || item) +
                       (1 + context * plausibility || subject),
                       data = data_spill4,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                             optCtrl=list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(spill4_mdl03)$varcor

spill4_mdl04 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + context + plausibility || item) +
                       (1 + context + plausibility || subject),
                       data = data_spill4,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                             optCtrl=list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(spill4_mdl04)$varcor

spill4_mdl05 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + context + plausibility | item) +
                       (1 + context + plausibility | subject),
                       data = data_spill4,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                             optCtrl=list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(spill4_mdl05)$varcor

spill4_mdl05 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + context + plausibility | item) +
                       (1 + context | subject),
                       data = data_spill4,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                             optCtrl=list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(spill4_mdl05)$varcor

spill4_mdl06 <- lmer(log(RT) ~ 1 + context * plausibility * z_CL +
                       (1 + context + plausibility | item) +
                       (1 | subject),
                       data = data_spill4,
                       control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                             optCtrl=list(maxfun = 1e6)))
summary(spill4_mdl06)

spill4_results <- as.data.frame(summary(spill4_mdl06)$coefficients)
spill4_CI <- confint(spill4_mdl06)
spill4_results <- cbind(spill4_results, spill4_CI[4:11,])
spill4_results <- tibble::rownames_to_column(spill4_results,"Fixed effects")
names(spill4_results) <- c("Fixed effects",
                           "β", "SE", "df",
                           "t", "p", "CI_lower", "CI_upper")
spill4_results <- spill4_results %>%
  mutate(p = p.adjust(p, method="bonferroni")) %>% 
  select("Fixed effects",
         "β", "SE", "t",
         "p", "CI_lower", "CI_upper")

spill4_results <- nice_table(spill4_results)
print(spill4_results, preview ="docx")
```

Resolve the significant interaction:

```{r}
spill4_emm1 <- emmeans(spill4_mdl06,"plausibility",
                by = c("context"),
                lmer.df="satterthwaite",
                adjust="bonferroni")
spill4_cont1 <- as.data.frame(contrast(spill4_emm1,"tukey"))
spill4_cont1

spill4_emm2 <- emmeans(spill4_mdl06,"context",
                by = c("plausibility"),
                lmer.df="satterthwaite",
                adjust="bonferroni")
spill4_cont2 <- as.data.frame(contrast(spill4_emm2,"tukey"))
spill4_cont2

data_spill4 %>% group_by(context,plausibility) %>% 
  summarise(mean(RT))

```

install.packages("simr")  # 처음 한 번만
library(simr)

run_simr <- function(region, n, effect_scale = 1,
                     nsim = 100, seed = 123) {

  set.seed(seed)

  # 원래 모델을 복사
  m <- models[[region]]
  term <- terms_to_test[[region]]

  # 검정할 효과 크기 설정
  fixef(m)[term] <- fixef(models[[region]])[term] *
    effect_scale

  # 4개 리스트를 균등하게 유지하는 새 참가자 데이터
  d <- new_design(datasets[[region]], n)

  # Contrast coding 재확인
  contrasts(d$context) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
  contrasts(d$plausibility) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)

  getData(m) <- d

  # Power simulation
  powerSim(
    m,
    test = fixed(term, method = "t"),
    nsim = nsim,
    alpha = 0.05,
    seed = seed
  )
}
